title: Setting Up Tailwind CSS with Vite
subtopics: Creating the main CSS entry file
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of setting up tailwind css with vite.
Apply one appropriate technique to a small Tailwind CSS example.
Verify the expected result and identify a common failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, focus on setting up tailwind css with vite and connect it to the way Tailwind CSS generates and applies utility styles.
content.why_it_matters: A repeatable setup for setting up tailwind css with vite prevents version and build-tool mismatches that can make valid utilities appear not to work.

content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: The source curriculum highlights: Creating a project; Installing the Tailwind package; Integrating the Vite plugin; Creating the main CSS entry file; Importing Tailwind CSS. Treat these as practical decisions rather than a list to memorize: identify the intended behavior, choose the smallest suitable utility or directive, and inspect what the browser receives.

content_blocks.title: Worked example: Setting Up Tailwind CSS with Vite
content_blocks.code:
npm create vite@latest my-app
cd my-app
npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
content_blocks.expected_output: A Vite scaffold with the official Tailwind CSS Vite integration installed.

content_blocks.title: Guided example
content_blocks.text: Start with the example, change one decision related to setting up tailwind css with vite, then compare the outcome. In a Tailwind-enabled project, confirm the generated CSS exists; class strings alone do not make styles available without a configured build.

content_blocks.title: Version and compatibility note
content_blocks.text: This course prioritizes Tailwind CSS v4. Confirm your installed version and use its matching official guide. Snippets using v3 directives or configuration are labelled as legacy and should not be mixed blindly with v4 syntax.

content.task: Set up a minimal Vite project with the official Tailwind v4 Vite integration and verify a heading utility.
task_acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate at least one decision tied to setting up tailwind css with vite.
Keep the example easy to inspect, with complete utility names.
Test the outcome and document one limitation or environment assumption.
hints: Identify which listed syllabus topic is most important to setting up tailwind css with vite.
Change one utility, token, variant or configuration setting at a time.
Inspect generated CSS and computed styles before changing unrelated code.
content.expected_output: A Vite scaffold with the official Tailwind CSS Vite integration installed.
troubleshooting: If no style appears, verify the package, CSS import and build-tool integration before changing the HTML.
If only a state or breakpoint style fails, check the full class token, source detection, condition and computed CSS.
For a framework snippet, import the stylesheet through its supported entry point and consult the current official guide.
common_mistakes: Applying setting up tailwind css with vite without checking generated styles or browser behavior.
Mixing Tailwind v3 and v4 setup examples without a migration plan.
Treating visual appearance as a substitute for semantic markup, keyboard usability or actual component behavior.
summary: Setting Up Tailwind CSS with Vite is one part of a predictable utility-first styling workflow.
Keep examples small, test the built interface and use version-matched documentation.
